items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Bob Robinson, Joe Waddle, and Edward J. Powers, the sax wizard. [INTERVIEWEE] Yep.

ctx.x: I'll have to look at the van. Mm-hmm. Well, you don't have the instruments there, you know. No. No. Shane Martin. Is that Shane Martin? No, Shane Martin. Shane. I think, uh... I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know. I don't know.
So they got Joe Mitchell, Bob Robinson, Victor Corsi.
I think that's Joe Mitchell, if I'm not mistaken. He played Gana. And he also played Sticks. Marimba. Marimba. Marimba.
